summary: Cold codegen (run-4 iter 1) of chemical_detector: 2 controllers, sensor service, Vehicle actuator, Clock, constants, events; all requirement ids traced in result_codegen.json.

issues.title: No Final states in either controller
issues.detail: Spec final state j1 (CD-GA-Beh6, CD-MV-Beh9) omitted per CLAUDE.md rule that the theory-generated controller must not contain Final. GasDetected reroutes to Reading after sending stop; Found self-loops on stop (idempotent flag/halt re-emission).

issues.title: Odometer modeled as sensor variable, not event
issues.detail: CD-Evt3's odometer?d0 / odometer?d1 occur inside actions, inexpressible as triggers in the one-event-per-step Java encoding; implemented as zero-arg DetectorSensors.odometerDistance() assignments.

issues.title: Vehicle operations are plain methods
issues.detail: CD-OP1..4 are platform operations invoked as actions (move/randomWalk/shortRandomWalk/changeDirection on Vehicle); no compute() operation classes needed.

issues.title: analysis() classification rule
issues.detail: 'Reading indicates target chemical' implemented as c == Chem.TARGET && i > 0. Chem is an invented two-literal enum (TARGET, OTHER).

issues.title: during randomWalk() as top-of-mode statement
issues.detail: Pipeline extracts entry, not during; randomWalk() placed at head of Waiting mode block per CLAUDE.md.

issues.title: Complementary guard pairs for total cover
issues.detail: Autonomous-only modes (Analysis, GasDetected, AvoidingAgain) use P / !P guard pairs so one transition is always enabled without self-loops.

issues.title: Constant values
issues.detail: THR=1.0, LV=1.0, EVADE_TIME=1, STUCK_PERIOD=1, STUCK_DIST=1.0, OUT_PERIOD=1 (within {0..1} CSP ranges).
